product_metadata.title: Nut Cracker and Lobster Opener, 6-Inch
features: This ChefLand lobster cracker is very durable and easy to use
Great for lobster, seafood, shell fish, oyster, crab shells and all of your favorite nuts
This zinc alloy utensil is very durable, Opens even the though ones
Double jaw device, to fit all sizes - dishwasher safe
Easy grip, durable and withstands wear and tear
description: This Aluminum Lobster Cracker is brought to you by ChefLand. Every lobster house needs a good lobster cracker; it's an absolute must for every meal that is served. ChefLand's lobster cracker is strong and made of durable stainless steel to withstand heavy wear and tear. It features jagged ridges and wide swing handles that can accommodate both large and small claws. Additionally, it's made for professional use, and can stand the rigors and repeated use and washing of a commercial kitchen.
